desc: Implement a memory-conscious input parser and frequency table for values up to \(10^6\), while retaining the original sequence for output.
Implement the divisor-multiples sieve to compute `count[d] = sum(freq[m])` over all multiples of \(d\).
Process divisors from largest to smallest; for every divisor with `count[d] >= K`, assign it to still-unanswered multiples.
Verify the characterization using edge cases such as \(K=1\), \(K=N\), duplicate values, and all values equal.
Optimize loops and storage so the total harmonic-series work and memory fit the \(N,\max A\le 1.2\times10^6\) limits.
